info.name: Navlungo Shipping API v1
info.description:
Sample collection for the Navlungo Shipping API (client_credentials). Documentation: https://github.com/Navlungo/public-api-docs/tree/main/en/shipping-api

Usage:
1. Fill in the clientId and clientSecret variables (provided by Navlungo; the secret is shared only once).
2. Environment: QA by default (api-qa / identity-qa). For production, baseUrl = https://api.navlungo.com, identityUrl = https://identity.navlungo.com.
3. Run the requests in order: 1. Get rates -> 2. Select rate -> 3-8. The token is obtained automatically; the reference/searchId/rateId variables are filled automatically in step 1.

Scopes: shipping_rates_write, shipping_shipments_write, shipping_shipments_read, shipping_labels_write. If a scope that is not defined for the client is requested, no token is issued; limit the scope variable to your client's scopes.

exec: // Obtains a new token with client_credentials if there is no token or it is about to expire.
// Credentials are read from the collection/environment variables; the token is written to the collection variable.
if (!clientId || !clientSecret) { console.warn('Fill in the clientId / clientSecret variables'); return; }
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error('Could not obtain token', err || res.json()); return; }

request.description: Issues an access token through the client_credentials flow (3600 s, no refresh token). The other requests obtain the token automatically; this request is only for obtaining/inspecting it manually.

originalRequest.description: Issues an access token through the client_credentials flow (3600 s, no refresh token). The other requests obtain the token automatically; this request is only for obtaining/inspecting it manually.

request.description: Scope: shipping_rates_write. Each call opens a new shipment reference. The reference, searchId and the first rate's rateId (with its required services) from the response are written to the collection variables. If there are no rates, 200 and rates: [] are returned.

request.description: Scope: shipping_labels_write + permission can_create_labels. No body. Idempotent: if already created, created: false. label is only returned with the can_download_labels permission and if the file has been produced.

Scope: shipping_shipments_write. An S3 upload address is returned for each document; upload the file within 5 minutes with a separate PUT, with Content-Type set to the contentType in the response. The first address is written to the uploadUrl variable.

exec: console.log('Upload the file with PUT within 5 minutes. Content-Type:', json.documents[0].contentType);

request.description: Scope: shipping_shipments_read. Delivered shipments only; the address must be used within 2 minutes. If the record comes from the Excel list, fileName and downloadUrl are null.

response.name: 400 Not delivered

request.description: Scope: shipping_shipments_write. Voids a shipment that has not arrived at the warehouse; no body. Voiding does not revoke a label that has already been created at the carrier.
